title: Family Portrait Outdoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A black and white mid-century family portrait depicting four adults standing side by side outdoors against leafy foliage. The group consists of a younger couple on the left—the man in high-waisted pleated trousers and a patterned tie, the woman in a mid-length dress with a scalloped waist—and an older couple on the right, featuring a man in a three-piece suit and an elderly woman wearing a polka-dot dress. The print features decorative scalloped deckled edges typical of mid-20th century photograph processing.
